exampleTranslation: 这是一幅现代建筑的真正杰作。

definition:
n. 鹊，喜鹊；饶舌的人；有收集零碎东西癖好的人
adj. 鹊的；有收集癖的；斑驳的，混杂的
exampleSentence: The magpie collected shiny objects and stored them in its nest.
exampleTranslation: 那只喜鹊收集了闪亮的物品并把它们存放在自己的巢里。

definition:
n. 投掷；摇荡；投掷的距离；掷币赌胜负
vt. 投掷；使…不安；突然抬起；使…上下摇动；与…掷币打赌
vi. 辗转；被乱扔；颠簸；掷钱币决定某事
exampleSentence: He tossed the coin into the air to decide who would go first.
exampleTranslation: 他把硬币抛向空中以决定谁先开始。

definition:
n. 抛弃；被丢弃的东西或人
vt. 抛弃；放弃；丢弃
vi. 放弃
exampleSentence: She decided to discard the old magazines.
exampleTranslation: 她决定扔掉旧杂志。

definition: n. 治安官，巡警；警察
exampleSentence: The constable arrived at the scene of the accident to investigate.
exampleTranslation: 治安官到达事故现场进行调查。

definition: vt. 洗劫，掠夺；遍寻
exampleSentence: The robbers ransacked the house and took everything they could find.
exampleTranslation: 强盗洗劫了房子，拿走了他们能找到的一切。

definition: n. 阳台；包厢；戏院楼厅
exampleSentence: The sheriff watched from the balcony.
exampleTranslation: 警长从阳台处观察着。

definition: adj. 爱挑剔的，难取悦的；易烦恼的
exampleSentence: He is a fussy customer who always complains about the service.
exampleTranslation: 他是个爱挑剔的顾客，总是抱怨服务。

definition: vt. 积聚，积累
exampleSentence: He amassed a large collection of rare books over the years.
exampleTranslation: 多年来，他积攒了一大批罕见的书籍。

definition: adj. 任意的；无差别的；不分皂白的
exampleSentence: The indiscriminate use of pesticides harms the environment.
exampleTranslation: 农药的任意使用会危害环境。

definition:
n. 杂乱，混乱
vt. 使凌乱；胡乱地填满
exampleSentence: There's too much clutter in the photo.
exampleTranslation: 这张照片里杂乱无章。

definition: n. 线，弦，细绳；一串，一行
exampleSentence: She tied a string around the package to keep it secure.
exampleTranslation: 她用一根绳子把包裹绑起来以确保安全。

definition:
n. 必需品
adj. 必备的，必不可少的；需要的
exampleSentence: This task is a requisite for completing the project on time.
exampleTranslation: 这是按时完成项目的一个必备条件。

definition: n. 狂热；狂躁；热衷
exampleSentence: Her mania for collecting stamps has taken over her life.
exampleTranslation: 她对集邮的狂热已经占据了她的生活。

definition:
n. 素描；略图；梗概
vt. 画素描或速写
vi. 画素描或速写
exampleSentence: She made a sketch of the room before painting it.
exampleTranslation: 她在开始绘画之前先画了房间的草图。

definition:
n. 远程
adj. 遥远的；偏僻的；疏远的
exampleSentence: The remote village is hard to reach because of the mountainous terrain.
exampleTranslation: 这个偏远村庄因为山地地形而难以到达。

definition: adj. 有主见的；意志坚强的
exampleSentence: She is a strong-minded person who always follows her own ideas.
exampleTranslation: 她是一个有主见的人，总是坚持自己的想法。

definition: n. 放松；缓和；消遣
exampleSentence: After a long day at work, he enjoyed some relaxation by watching a movie.
exampleTranslation: 工作一天后，他通过看电影来放松。

definition: vt. 核实；查证
exampleSentence: Please verify the information before submitting the form.
exampleTranslation: 请在提交表格前核实信息。

definition:
n. [机] 轴承；关系；方位；举止
v. 忍受（bear的ing形式）
exampleSentence: The bearing of the machine is crucial for its operation.
exampleTranslation: 这台机器的轴承对其运行至关重要。

definition: adj. 志趣相投的；具有相似意向或目的的
exampleSentence: They are like-minded and often work together on projects.
exampleTranslation: 他们志趣相投，经常一起合作项目。

definition: n. 样品，样本；标本
exampleSentence: This specimen is used to test the quality of the product.
exampleTranslation: 这个样品用于测试产品质量。

definition: adv. 建设性地
exampleSentence: She gave a constructively critical feedback during the meeting.
exampleTranslation: 她在会议上给出了建设性的批评意见。

definition:
v. 使…满足；使…安心（content的过去式和过去分词）
adj. 满足的；心安的
exampleSentence: He contented himself with the idea that he had done his best.
exampleTranslation: 他心安理得地认为自己已经尽力了。

definition: n. 厌倦；令人厌烦的事物
exampleSentence: The long lecture caused a lot of boredom among the students.
exampleTranslation: 冗长的讲座让学生们感到厌倦。

definition: n. 严守时间；正确；规矩
exampleSentence: Her punctuality is highly appreciated by the team.
exampleTranslation: 她的守时精神受到团队的高度赞赏。

definition: adj. 农村的，乡下的；田园的，有乡村风味的
exampleSentence: The rural area is known for its peaceful and natural scenery.
exampleTranslation: 这个乡村地区以宁静而自然的风景闻名。

definition:
n. 忽视；不尊重
vt. 忽视；不理；漠视；不顾

exampleTranslation: 他无视规则，因此对后果漠不关心。

definition:
n. 知识分子；凭理智做事者
adj. 智力的；聪明的；理智的
exampleSentence: The intellectual community often debates the role of technology in society.
exampleTranslation: 知识分子群体经常讨论技术在社会中的作用。

definition: adj. 深奥的；难懂的
exampleSentence: The theory is so abstruse that only a few experts can understand it.
exampleTranslation: 这个理论如此深奥，只有少数专家才能理解。

definition:
n. 坐标；同等的人或物
vt. 调整；整合
adj. 并列的；同等的
vi. 协调

exampleTranslation: 经理协调团队高效地完成了任务。

definition:
n. 责备；耻辱
vt. 责备；申斥

exampleTranslation: 父母经常责备孩子没有完成作业。

definition:
n. 穿刺；刺痕

vi. 被刺穿；被戳破

exampleTranslation: 医生刺穿病人的手臂以抽血。

definition: n. 转移；消遣；分散注意力

exampleTranslation: 另一个瓦工，对从单调劳动中得到任何消遣感到高兴，也转过头去看指定的区域。

definition:
n. 试验；审讯；努力；磨炼
adj. 试验的；审讯的

exampleTranslation: 被告的审讯持续了好几个星期。

definition: n. 分数；部分；小部分；稍微

exampleTranslation: 这只是总成本的一小部分。

definition:
n. 兴旺；茂盛；挥舞；炫耀；华饰

vt. 夸耀；挥舞

exampleTranslation: 这家公司因为创新产品而蓬勃发展。

definition: adj. 微观的；用显微镜可见的
exampleSentence: The microscopic, one-celled aquatic plants are known as essential primary-producers, which form the base of the food chain for sea life.
exampleTranslation: 这些微观的、单细胞的水生植物被称为关键的初级生产者，构成了海洋生物的食物链基础。

definition:
n. 坚硬的东西；坚石
adj. 固执的，坚强的；坚定不移的；坚硬无比的

exampleTranslation: 他固执己见的态度让所有人都感到惊讶。
